description:
List the schema proposals on a graph: each proposal's ID, title, status (DRAFT, OPEN, APPROVED, IMPLEMENTED, CLOSED), timestamps, author, the source variant it proposes changes to, and the proposal variant that holds its changes, plus the total count for the filter.
A schema proposal is a reviewable set of schema changes that GraphOS stores on its own variant.
Pass a proposal's id to GetProposal for its revisions and reviews.
Provide the graph ID.
Optionally filter by status, source variant names, or subgraph names, and page with limit and offset.
